# meshoptimizer decoder

`meshopt-decoder.js` is the unmodified `meshopt_decoder.mjs` from meshoptimizer 1.3.0, renamed for the game's JavaScript MIME handling. It decodes the prebuilt lookout scenery; the encoder and simplifier are offline development dependencies only.

Upstream: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer
